title: Explicit MPC Controller
text: Explicit model predictive controller, 6 inputs, 4 outputs, {Block data type} sets data type of manipulated variables; {Explicit MPC Controller} sets the explicit controller object explicitMPC object, {Initial Controller State} sets the initial state mpcstate, {Measured disturbance} adds measured disturbance input port, {External manipulated variable} adds external manipulated variable input, {Status of piecewise affine function evaluation} adds evaluation status output port, {Region number of evaluated piecewise affine function} adds region number output port, {Estimated controller states} adds estimated states output port, {Use custom state estimation instead of using the built-in Kalman filter} uses custom state estimate input port, {Inherit sample time} sets the inherit block sample time from parent and {Use external signal to enable controller evaluation} adds a switch-off input port. Values come from the instance.
